title: Sealed plaintext
description: What the envelope of secrets-answer.schema.json opens to: the digest, the set of connections and the values by secret id and value id, nothing else. The runner checks run_configuration against the digest it computed and connections against the set it sent. The pairs of secret and value_id are exactly the distinct pairs those connections reference with an id, each once, sorted by secret and then by value_id, a value without one first. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object.

version.description: The document format. A runner refuses a version it does not read.

run_configuration.description: The digest of the rendering the values were sealed from, sha256= and 64 lower-case hex digits.

connections.description: The connections of the request, sorted.

values.description: The stored values, at most 32 and 512 KiB in all.

secret.description: The secret's id: sec_ and 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

value_id.description: The value's id within a secret with several values; absent for a secret with one value.

value.description: The value: UTF-8 text with no NUL. The schema bounds it at 16384 characters; the runner and the server hold it to 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8. A value set in a header also has no control character other than tab and no leading or trailing space or tab; the runner checks that where it uses the value.
